data.description:
## What
Create plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh — a bash helper that converts a recipe task spec (recipe name, params, intent) to a natural-language LLM sub-agent task description when the recipe engine is unavailable.

## Why
TDD GREEN phase: implement the translation helper to make RED tests from 72e4-05bd pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Script exists at plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh and is executable
- Accepts: --recipe=<name> --intent=<capability_description text> [--param key=value ...] [--output-format=task-prompt]
- Reads recipe registry to get canonical capability_description if --intent not provided
- Default output: multi-line natural-language task description:
  Line 1: 'Implement the following mechanical transform manually: <capability_description>'
  Line 2+: 'Context: This task was planned as a recipe task (<recipe_name>) but the required engine is unavailable. Apply the transform using LLM generation.'
  If params present: 'Parameters: <key1>=<value1>, <key2>=<value2>'
- --output-format=task-prompt: wraps in ## What / ## Why / ## Acceptance Criteria / ## Testing Mode structure, with testing_mode: GREEN
- RECIPE_REGISTRY_PATH env var overrides registry path
- All tests in test-translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh pass

## File Impact
- CREATE: plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh

## Testing Mode
GREEN — make failing tests pass

## Dependencies
- 72e4-05bd (RED tests must exist first)
data.title: GREEN: Implement translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh
